h: Kogi APC group warns Faleke-Audu loyalists over alleged anti-party moves
p: A group within the Kogi APC has reportedly cautioned loyalists of Faleke and Audu over alleged anti-party activity ahead of 2027. The loyalists have not yet publicly responded.
more: Internal party tensions are surfacing in several states as primaries and campaigns advance.
The party has not announced any disciplinary action.
